verdict.rationale: Zero's documented self-hosting lets a user run the app on infrastructure they choose, which gives indirect control over where app-side data lives. There is no documented region or residency selector for the hosted service. The README says emails are stored in a Durable Object and an R2 bucket, but no region-pinning options are described. missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection for hosted users, documentation of where Durable Object/R2 data resides or how to pin it, independent corroboration of residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: gives users the power to **self-host** their own email app
Self-Hosting Freedom – Run your own email app with ease.
We're now storing the user's emails in their Durable Object & an R2 bucket.
